title: Set Reorder Points Request
description: An array of reorder point entries to upsert.

ReorderPointFixedRequestItem.description: A reorder point entry using the `FIXED` method.

outlet_id.description: The ID of the outlet the reorder point applies to.

product_id.description: The ID of the product the reorder point applies to.

reorder_amount.description: The static quantity to order each time the reorder point is triggered.

reorder_point.description: The minimum inventory level below which a product is automatically suggested for reordering.

ReorderPointFixedRequestItem.title: Reorder Point Fixed Request Item

ReorderPointMinMaxRequestItem.description: A reorder point entry using the `MIN_MAX` method.

outlet_id.description: The ID of the outlet the reorder point applies to.

product_id.description: The ID of the product the reorder point applies to.

reorder_point.description: The minimum inventory level below which a product is automatically suggested for reordering.

reorder_target.description: The desired stock level to restore to when reordering.

ReorderPointMinMaxRequestItem.title: Reorder Point Min/Max Request Item
